Tunnel Collapse in Uttarakhand Kills Seven, Three Missing

Seven workers have died and three remain missing following a tunnel collapse at a hydropower project in Uttarakhand's Chamoli district. Debris and water entered the tunnel, leading to the incident. Rescue operations are underway to find the missing individuals. The incident occurred at the THDC India Ltd. project.
